description: This Dart source file defines a ContentService class responsible for loading book chapter content from bundled assets within a Flutter application. It provides methods to load an index of chapters, retrieve chapter details by ID, cache content for performance, and handle errors gracefully.

classes.name: ContentService
classes.description: A singleton service class responsible for loading and caching book chapter data from asset files.

methods.name: loadIndex
methods.description: Loads and decodes the chapters index JSON file from assets. Returns a map containing chapter metadata.

methods.name: getChapters
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Chapter objects for all chapters listed in the index, employing caching to minimize repeated file reads.

methods.name: getChapterById
methods.description: Fetches a specific Chapter object by its ID, using cache if available, otherwise loading from the specified file.

methods.name: _loadChapterFromFile
methods.description: Private helper method to load a chapter JSON file and parse it into a Chapter object.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears the internal caches to allow reloading content, useful during development or hot-reloads.
